title: Controlling the maximum length of the answer

videos.script: A limit on the length of an answer is a pair of scissors. When the model reaches it, writing stops, wherever it is. {{title}} Set it to twenty-five tokens on the triage prompt and watch. Twenty-nine replies of forty are cut off before they close, and four of forty pass. {{check}} The reason is in how a reply is counted. A token is not a word, and in a JSON answer many tokens are quotes, braces and field names. {{tokens}} Asking for a shorter summary is a different tool. The model writes a shorter sentence, and the brace still closes. The cap only decides where writing ends. {{ask}} You need both. The request shapes the answer, and the cap sits well above it, measured. Add one field to the answer, and a cap set at the old maximum turns seven right answers into exceptions. {{measure}} By the end of this lesson you can count what a reply costs, choose a cap from a measurement, and treat every reply that hit it as a failure. {{close}}
